steps.name: Dismiss a system alert if present
steps.goal: If Apple Account Verification is visible, tap Not Now in that system alert. Otherwise do not tap anything.
steps.done: The app data notice is visible.

steps.name: Accept fixture data notice
steps.goal: Tap Agree and continue on the fixture data notice. Do not tap Not now. Wait for Home. Do not tap the root element named omg.

steps.name: Open the working session
steps.goal: On Home, tap the api-gateway folder chip in the project rail. Then open the conversation titled Refactor the rate limiter to a sliding window. Do not type a message.
steps.done: The conversation screen is open and shows the newest reply and the idle follow check.

steps.name: Open keyboard with a draft
steps.goal: Tap the message composer and type Keyboard draft kept. Leave the keyboard open. Do not send the message.
steps.done: The draft Keyboard draft kept is in the message composer.

steps.name: Read back a little
steps.goal: Do not tap anything. Wait for the swipe to finish.
steps.done: The transcript has moved down to show an earlier reply, and the follow check is waiting.

steps.name: Return to the bottom
steps.goal: If a button labelled Jump to the latest is shown, tap it once. Otherwise do not tap anything.
steps.done: The newest message is visible above the composer, and the follow check is watching.

steps.name: Transcript holds still while the agent works
steps.goal: Do not tap or swipe anything. Wait until the follow check line says passed or failed.
steps.done: The follow check line has finished watching.

steps.name: Long press the reply
steps.goal: Touch and hold the final paragraph beginning If anything goes wrong. Do not tap the message composer.
steps.done: The iOS action sheet offers Copy, Select text, and Cancel.

steps.name: Select reply text
steps.goal: Tap Select text in the action sheet.
steps.done: The selection screen contains the full reply and copy controls.

steps.name: Return with the draft intact
steps.goal: Tap Done to return to the conversation.
steps.done: The original reply and unsent draft are still visible.
